purpose: Contract C rule R11 is the ONLY path to indexation for a non-factual institutional page (home, methodology, navigation). A Gate 12-I PASS is necessary but never sufficient. A certification records governance=governed, validation=validated, release=authorized, and that the page asserts no factual claim. Only status 'certified' entries are used.

gate12i_evidence.result: Gate 12-I PASS; SEO head/structure/link checks PASS (2026-10-30)

certifications.non_factual_basis: The page asserts no chemistry or terminology fact. Counts about the site's own records are computed from the registries ({{GOV:...}}); the bisulfid/bisulfide question is routed to the terminology reference, not answered on the homepage.
owner_actions_required: confirm the editorial-responsibility wording (publisher = domain owner; no named reviewer)
decide whether to publish an editorial/corrections contact (the only verified address, on /acquire/, is commercial)
approve replacing the live legacy homepage body (live-HTML change, own PR)
then set status 'certified' with certified_by/certified_on; until then R11 does not apply
